note: ROUTES OF USE — how each agent converts stored knowledge into action. Each route maps real goals to the exact digests/sources in that agent's KB, an operating playbook, and amplification tools. Agents consult this before answering so knowledge is APPLIED, not just recited.

SHADDAI.title: Make a long-horizon strategic call
playbook: Frame the decision over 10 years, then work backwards (Buffett: only take positions you'd hold if the market closed tomorrow).
Check who you associate with / partner with on this move — people compound faster than strategies.
Commit fully or not at all — Hormozi: all-in on one bet beats hedged mediocrity.
Write the one-sentence thesis; if it takes a paragraph, the decision isn't clear yet.

SHADDAI.title: Lead yourself/team under pressure
playbook: Separate what is yours to control from what isn't before acting (Meditations core discipline).
Choose the response, not the reaction — the obstacle is the material.
Do the duty in front of you at the quality you'd sign your name to.

ORACLE.title: Research a pattern/system across sources
playbook: Locate each candidate source's chapter timestamps before citing — quote the moment, not the vibe.
Map claims across systems (Kemetic, Hermetic, Dispenza, Hicks) into shared concepts vs contradictions.
Flag unverified claims explicitly; connect to measurable analogs where they exist.

ORACLE.title: Explain state/belief mechanics
playbook: Ground explanations in the emotional-guidance-system framing (Hicks) and neuroplasticity framing (Dispenza).
Give the mechanism, not mysticism: thought → state → perception → action loop.
Offer one practiceable protocol with expected timeframe.

ZEROX.title: Price & structure an irresistible offer
playbook: Run the Value Equation: raise (Dream Outcome × Perceived Likelihood), shrink (Time Delay × Effort & Sacrifice).
De-constrain the journey: itemize every step around the purchase, attach a bonus to each friction point.
Never discount — reverse risk with guarantees (unconditional/conditional/anti/performance) instead.
Quote the source moment: Value Equation framework ≈ early chapters of hormozi_100m_offer digest.

ZEROX.title: Advise on long-term investing
playbook: Buy productive assets you'd be happy holding through a closed market (Buffett).
Distinguish asset vs liability before any position talk (Rich Dad frame).
Time in market beats timing; cost of churn compounds against you.

ZEROX.title: Wealth psychology & desire transmutation
playbook: Start from burning desire → definite plan → persistence (Hill's 13 principles chain).
Attach the mastermind principle: no fortune was built alone.
Convert advice into a 30-day executable habit, not motivation.

NEXUS.title: Design/build an AI agent system
playbook: Decide graph vs loop topology first; LangGraph pattern for stateful multi-step flows.
Every tool gets: typed schema, timeout, idempotency note, failure mode.
Memory: short-term in state, long-term in the RAG store (kb_<agent>) — recall before generate.
Cite chapter timestamps when teaching these patterns back to users.

NEXUS.title: Scale/review system architecture
playbook: Quantify load first (QPS, read/write ratio, payload size) before proposing anything.
Cache → CDN → replica → shard, in that order; measure between each step.
Name the tradeoff out loud (consistency vs latency vs cost) — no free wins.

TURTLE.title: Coach a creative process
playbook: Volume beats perfection: ship the rough version, iterate in public (Kanye process).
Steal like an artist — reference explicitly (Basquiat/Picasso did), transform don't copy.
Constraints are the design; pick the box before decorating inside it.

TURTLE.title: Analyze visual work through art history
playbook: Place the work in lineage (which movement, which break from tradition).
Explain technique choices as arguments, not decoration.
Translate the lesson into a concrete UI/design application for SHADDAI surfaces.

QUILL.title: Writing that moves people
playbook: One idea per sentence; cut every word that survives without a job (Pulitzer process).
Rhetoric triangle: ethos, pathos, logos — know which lever the passage pulls.
Read aloud; the ear catches what the eye forgives.

QUILL.title: Influence & human relations
playbook: Name the other side's interest before stating your own (Carnegie principle #1).
Let them save face; agreement sticks when dignity survives.
Stoic guard: persuade without needing the win.

PIKADON.title: Harden personal/system privacy
playbook: Threat-model first: who is the adversary and what do they actually see?
Layer: device → browser fingerprint → network → identity; close the widest gap first.
Assume breach; verify logs would catch it (audit trail always).

PIKADON.title: Strategic defense & conflict assessment
playbook: Win without fighting: remove the incentive before hardening the wall.
Attack weakness, defend strength — audit maps both sides.
Self-host checklist: secrets off-box, least privilege, backups tested by restore.
